name: Candidate Acceptance - AI Agent Workflow
description: Send candidate acceptance with AI-generated personalized email and calendar event creation

options.systemMessage: You are a professional HR assistant. Your task is to create a warm, professional acceptance email for a candidate. The email should congratulate them, inform them about the interview, and provide all necessary details. Keep it concise but friendly.

parameters.subject: Congratulations! Interview Confirmed - {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.position }}
parameters.htmlMessage:
Congratulations!

Hi {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.candidateName }},

We are excited to inform you that you have advanced to the next stage of our interview process for the {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.position }} role at {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.company }}.

Position: {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.position }}
Interview Date: {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.interviewDate }}
Interview Time: {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.interviewTime }} {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.timezone }}
Duration: 60 minutes

Please ensure your microphone and camera are working properly. You will receive a calendar invitation separately with the meeting link.

If you have any questions or need to reschedule, please don't hesitate to reach out.

We look forward to speaking with you soon!

Best regards,
Recruitment Team
{{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.company }}

parameters.title: Interview: {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.candidateName }} - {{ $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.position }}
parameters.endTime: ={{ new Date(new Date($node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.interviewDate + 'T' + $node["Parse Webhook Data"].json.interviewTime).getTime() + 60*60000).toLocaleTimeString() }}

parameters.body: {"candidate_name": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.candidateName }}", "candidate_email": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.candidateEmail }}", "position": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.position }}", "interview_date": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.interviewDate }}", "interview_time": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.interviewTime }}", "timezone": "={{ $node[\"Parse Webhook Data\"].json.timezone }}", "status": "acceptance_sent"}
